description.value: Established in 1992, Murrayville Town Pub is a long-standing Langley neighbourhood pub known for its warm, community-oriented atmosphere. It boasts over 200 seats, pool tables, and 20 screens for sports, plus an adjoining private banquet room called Manhattans. The pub has raised over $100,000 for Big Brothers & Sisters and is deeply embedded in the local Murrayville community.
